components.css: .ds-rail { width: 13rem; padding: 2rem 1.5rem; color: var(--parchment); background: var(--night); font: 400 1rem/1.5 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-app-name { font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-navigation { display: grid; gap: .5rem; margin-top: 2.75rem; } .ds-navigation-link { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: .625rem 1rem; border-radius: 4px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: .2em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-navigation-link[aria-current='page'] { font-weight: 600; } .ds-navigation-link[aria-current='page']::before { position: absolute; inset: .625rem auto .625rem 0; width: 3px; background: var(--lantern); content: ''; } .ds-navigation-link:hover, .ds-navigation-link:active { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-navigation-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--parchment); outline-offset: -6px; } .ds-scope { margin: 1.5rem 0 0; font-size: .875rem; }

components.name: Compact navigation

components.html: GroundCaptureThinkRecall
components.css: .ds-compact-navigation { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0; padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px); color: var(--parchment); background: var(--night); font: 400 .875rem/1.5 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-compact-link { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: var(--navigation-height); padding: .75rem 4px; border-radius: 0; color: inherit; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: .2em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-compact-link[aria-current='page'] { font-weight: 600; } .ds-compact-link[aria-current='page']::before { position: absolute; inset: 0 .75rem auto; height: 3px; background: var(--lantern); content: ''; } .ds-compact-link:hover, .ds-compact-link:active { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-compact-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--parchment); outline-offset: -6px; }

narrative.overview:
Stable navigation sits beside a replaceable work surface. Night now extends across navigation and workspace, with readable Parchment text and thin Parchment notice boundaries. Spacing, alignment, and type weight separate areas without adding new surface hues. The personal brand appears through exact color roles and a single interface family.

This is a task-focused interface, not a promotional surface. The system is flat and restrained: no hero imagery, decorative brand motifs, shadows, or entrance choreography. Unavailable functionality is explained plainly rather than illustrated with invented activity. Dark is the default even when the operating system prefers light; there is no theme switch or stored preference.
keyCharacteristics: A unified Night field with a purposeful selection accent.
One locally served interface family in regular and semibold.
Flat boundaries, visible focus, and honest empty states.

rules.name: The Purposeful Accents Rule
rules.body: Use accent color for a real selection or information role, not to fill empty space.

rules.name: The One Interface Voice Rule
rules.body: Use regular and semibold Source Sans 3 for working interface text; do not introduce a display face to decorate a task.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate work areas with fields, spacing, or a single rule rather than decorative depth.

dos: Do keep selection, keyboard focus, and unavailable-feature copy distinct.
Do preserve native links, readable wrapping, and document scrolling.
Do use local font files with their OFL and recorded provenance.
Do measure contrast for any new rendered color pairing.
donts: Don't add decorative art, taglines, shadows, gradients, or simulated activity to the working shell.
Don't replace the approved navigation marker with an unrelated accent treatment.
Don't turn Horizon or panel-only tonal ramps into invented status colors.
Don't infer button, input, loading, or error styles from components this phase does not contain.
